title: Enhancing Trust Through Standards: A Comparative Risk-Impact Framework for Aligning ISO AI Standards with Global Ethical and Regulatory Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not empirically measure specific biases within an AI model's outputs. Instead, it evaluates 'bias' as a macro-level regulatory and ethical risk. It uses a Comparative Risk-Impact Assessment Framework to score the severity and likelihood of bias in different legal jurisdictions (e.g., the EU AI Act, US-Colorado AI Act) and evaluates how effectively ISO standards (such as ISO/IEC 24027) mitigate these risks.
